name: Grain Spirit
description:
A clear grain spirit with a sharp nose and little sweetness. The tapkeeper measures it into a small cup rather than filling a beer mug.

One purchase supplies one 1 fl oz measure of spirit. The inn retains its serving vessel; takeaway requires your own suitable container. Alcohol effects are left to the GM.
saleUnit: One 1 fl oz measure of spirit

weight.notes: Contents-only weight of one 1 fl oz measure of spirit, using the project liquid allowance of 1 lb per pint (small spirit measures rounded to 0.06 lb). The inn retains its vessel; carried containers weigh separately.
